mapper.select: SELECT sa.id, sa.name, sa.introduction, sa.cover_image_file_id, COALESCE(sf.url, '/static/default-cover.svg') AS cover_image_url, sa.longitude, sa.latitude, sa.status, sa.created_at, sa.updated_at FROM street_area sa LEFT JOIN stored_file sf ON sa.cover_image_file_id = sf.id WHERE sa.id=#{id}
